prompt: A low-poly 3D floating island: a small chunk of land built from faceted, flat-shaded polygons with crisp edges, its rocky underside tapering to a point, hovering in empty space. On the island: A warm outdoor patio of terracotta tile is bounded by a low ivy-draped brick wall at the back. Overhead, crisscrossing strands of glowing bulb string lights cast amber light across the scene. At the center, a long wooden dining table is laden with pasta plates and glassware. On the left, a small figure in a dark shirt and white apron sets down a square tiramisu topped with a fizzing, bright golden sparkler. Three friends in colorful sweaters sit around the table, leaning forward in delight. Clean stylized game-asset look with simple geometric shapes, soft pastel gradients and tiny low-poly figures. The whole world is one compact object, centered, filling about two thirds of the frame with empty space on every side, seen from a three-quarter angle slightly above. Plain seamless pale gray background with nothing else in it. Soft, even, diffuse light with only a gentle contact shadow; everything in crisp focus. No text, letters, numbers, signs or logos anywhere.
